definitions.explanation: A Japanese dish consisting of vinegared rice combined with various ingredients, typically raw fish, seafood, vegetables, or egg.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きませんか→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Shall we go to a conveyor belt sushi restaurant?
examples.notes: Note the rendaku: すし becomes ずし in compounds

examples.japanese: ⟦{握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}→握り寿司：19145_nigirizushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{十|じゅっ}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{貫|かん}→貫：noentry⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered ten pieces of nigiri sushi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寿司|すし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Sushi with fresh toppings is exceptional.
examples.notes: ネタ means the topping/ingredient on sushi

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}→巻き寿司：12410_makizushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手巻|てま}き{寿司|ずし}→手巻き寿司：15996_temakizushi⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had a hand-roll sushi party with friends.

notes:
Also written as {鮨|すし} or {鮓|すし}. Types include:
- ⟦{握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}→握り寿司：19145_nigirizushi⟧ (hand-pressed sushi)
- ⟦{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}→巻き寿司：12410_makizushi⟧ (rolled sushi)
- ⟦{押|お}し{寿司|ずし}→押し寿司：22489_oshizushi⟧ (pressed sushi)
- ⟦{散|ち}らし{寿司|ずし}→ちらし寿司：10513_chirashizushi⟧ (scattered sushi)
- ⟦{手巻|てま}き{寿司|ずし}→手巻き寿司：15996_temakizushi⟧ (hand rolls)

Sushi terminology:
- ⟦シャリ→しゃり：15383_shari⟧ (vinegared rice)
- ⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧ (topping)
- ⟦ガリ→ガリ：27408_gari⟧ (pickled ginger)
- ⟦むらさき→紫：00297_murasaki⟧ (soy sauce - sushi shop term)
- ⟦あがり→上がり：25038_agari⟧ (green tea - sushi shop term)

Counter: ⟦{一貫|いっかん}→一貫：noentry⟧, ⟦{二貫|にかん}→二貫：noentry⟧... (pieces of nigiri).
